Senior Developer (f/m/d)

Date: 09/02/2026
Company: SAP

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

What you'll do:

Summary:

The BTP Fabric unit addresses all architectural and conceptional questions to ensure engineering excellence throughout SAP, and takes responsibility for operationalizing the CTO function across all board areas. BTP Fabric is also responsible for SAP’s overall platform and technology development such as SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP Core).

We are looking for a (Senior) Engineer to strengthen our Application Performance Management (APM) team in Walldorf. Our work environment offers an exciting mix of opportunities, a collaborative and energetic team of technology professionals, and the opportunity to work with leading Infrastructure and Platform-as-a-Service technologies (for example, Kubernetes).

As a (Senior) Engineer, you will bridge the gap between application and infrastructure, in terms of technical and organizational matters. If you are highly motivated, self-driven, enjoy working with international teams and eager to learn, then we want to hear from you.

The Role:

- Programming (mostly) in Golang (Kubernetes Operators, REST APIs, libraries and tools)
- Designing solutions providing new features for our customers
- Develop and operate highly scalable cloud solutions
- Knowledge in providing a seamless experience for engineers in a multi-tenancy cloud environment, including path to production, observability and metrics
- Automating tasks, especially self healing mechanisms of the platform
- Supporting development teams in their daily operational work is native to you
- Checking out new technologies and introducing them to others to promote innovation and create business value is your inner motivation
- Explaining technical problems and understanding business requirements comes naturally for you
- Bug Fixing and the work on user requests concerning the designed software
- On Call Duty if the self healing mechanisms were not sufficient

What you bring:

Required skills:

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Software Engineering, or a related technical field or comparable education
- 5+ years of experience working as a developer
- Experienced in Go, Java, Python or Bash/Power Shell supplemented by having experience in managing cloud infrastructure (e.g. with Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker etc.) and exposure to tools for configuration management
- Good knowledge of operating Linux/Unix based systems, understanding kernel, shell, scripting, etc.
- Familiarity with at least one cloud solution such as Amazon AWS, Azure, Google, Openstack
- Experience with containers and orchestration platforms (Docker, Kubernetes or others)
- Having good knowledge on SOLID, DRY and KISS principles
- Code management using e.g., GitLab and GitHub
- Solid understanding of software design, engineering and architecture principles
- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to drill down to the code level
- Knowledge about "Clean Code” and being determined to improve on quality all the time
- Very good written and verbal English language skills

Preferred skills:

- Practical experience with observability, monitoring, and analytics tooling (e.g. Dynat , Grafana, ELK)
- Practical experience/understanding of agile concepts (e.g., Scrum, Kanban, pair programming) and lean principles
- Experience with Continuous Delivery processes

Artificial Intelligence and machine learning are at the cutting edge when it comes to shaping next-gen mobility in areas like automated driving. Professional English proficiency, German is a plus.

As an (Associate) Vice President (f/m/d) at Siemens Advanta’s Strategy and Innovation Practice, you will serve as a senior leader overseeing pivotal domains: Delivery, Business Development, and People & Capability Building. Leveraging advanced expertise and leadership acumen, you will help define the next era of digitalization by crafting groundbreaking strategies and transformation roadmaps for Siemens and its global customers. The role entails direct responsibility for shaping business success, managing high-value projects, and serving as a trusted advisor for customer executives at C-level.Building on Siemens Advanta’s legacy as a global management consultancy powerhouse, the (Associate) Vice President role combines strategic depth, operational ownership, and cultural leadership—providing exposure to innovation-driven industries such as electrification, automation, and digitalization. **Ready to take your vision to the next level? Be part of a team where strategy meets technology, and innovation drives global impact.**How you will make an impact with us:

- Delivery Excellence:- Act as a trusted advisor to our customers, shaping strategic agendas and transformation roadmaps with your thought leadership.- Take operational and financial responsibility for acquiring and delivering high quality projects.- Oversee multidisciplinary teams in complex consulting engagements and large-scale programs to deliver innovative, tailored digital and organizational solutions for global industrial customers.

What you bring:

- Experience & Skills- Extensive consulting experience (8 - 12+ years), with a proven track record as Principal, (Associate) Partner or VP at a top-tier strategy consultancy, or equivalent experience in corporate strategy roles.- Track record in driving significant business growth**,** leading large-scale transformation programs, and building executive-level customer relationships.- Proven track record in leading digital transformation projects for Siemens’ customer base, focusing on industries like automotive and power & utilities.- AI expertise: Strong familiarity with AI-based strategy development and execution, leveraging AI to create impactful industry transformations.- End-to-end experience, ranging from strategy development to hands-on execution for technology-driven and industry-specific transformation projects.- Methodological depth in areas such as Target Operating Model (TOM), cost reduction initiatives, sustainability, and AI transformation.

- Pathway 1: For candidates working in Munich and supporting primarily German-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in English is mandatory, while German is an advantage.- Pathway 2: For candidates working in Barcelona and supporting primarily Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in Spanish is mandatory, with proficiency in Portugese preferred.

- Attractive Compensation Package: A competitive salary that recognizes your expertise and performance.- Flexible Working Models: Enjoy time for yourself and your family through our flexible working hour models.- Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date.- Innovative Environment: Become part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement.

The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

The DKFZ is a place where the brightest minds pursue bold ideas and seek answers to pioneering scientific questions through collaboration, innovation, and exploration across many disciplines. We provide a dynamic environment which empowers excellence with state-of-the-art technologies, cutting edge infrastructure, and a global scientific network.

Contribute your knowledge, vision, and dedication to create a space where scientific discovery in cancer research is transformed into benefits for human health.

Together with selected university partner sites, the German Cancer Research Center has established the German Cancer Consortium (https://dktk.dkfz.de/en) (Deutsches Konsortium für Translationale Krebsforschung, DKTK). The alliance between the DKFZ, as the core center, and the university partner sites in Berlin, Dresden, Essen/Düsseldorf, Frankfurt/Mainz, Freiburg, Heidelberg, Munich, and Tübingen joins forces at eight joint translation centers. The DKTK promotes interdisciplinary preclinical translational research topics to accelerate the transfer of results into new approaches for prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of cancer and to develop strategies for personalized oncology. The consortium supports the training of the next generation of medical and clinician scientists, operates state-of-the-art, highly specialized research infrastructures and technical platforms, and promotes the transfer of innovations to the economy and society.

For the Research Group "Adaptive Glycan Remodeling in Cancer Progression" (https://amulyasreekumar.owlstown.net/)  (headed by Amulya Sreekumar) at the DKTK partner site Berlin, the DKFZ is seeking, starting in January 2027, a PhD Student in Cancer Biology.

We are seeking a highly motivated PhD student to investigate the mechanisms driving breast cancer progression. Approximately 30% of breast cancer patients who are disease-free after initial therapy ultimately develop local or metastatic recurrences seeded by therapy-evasive residual tumor cells. Such cells often exist in a dormant state and subsequently exit dormancy, thus giving rise to recurrences. We are interested in the molecular mechanisms that promote residual tumor cell persistence after therapy and their subsequent reactivation.
Building on our recent discovery that tumor cell-autonomous glycan biosynthesis supports dormant cell persistence, this project aims to identify therapeutic strategies that disrupt glycan-mediated signaling to eliminate residual tumor cells and prevent lethal recurrence. The work will integrate mechanistic molecular biology, functional genomics, and advanced cancer models to achieve this goal.

The successful candidate will join the DKFZ International PhD Program (https://www.dkfz.de/en/career/international-phd-program) and work in a collaborative environment spanning DKFZ and Charité/DKTK Berlin. This partnership provides access to cutting-edge core facilities, including high-content imaging, flow cytometry, and genomics technologies at both institutions.
Our laboratory is located within the Department of Hematology, Oncology, and Cancer Immunology at Charité-Campus Virchow Klinikum in Berlin.

Your Tasks

- Performing molecular biology, cell biology, and biochemistry experiments using human and murine breast cancer models 
- Working with genetically engineered mouse models and transplantable tumors
- Gaining problem-solving and analytical skills through active participation and training
- Integration and interpretation of data 
- Presenting research findings at national/international conferences
- Contributing to high-impact scientific publications

Your Profile

- Master's degree in biology, biochemistry, or a related life sciences discipline 
- Strong interest in cancer research and the molecular mechanisms underlying disease progression
- Practical experience in molecular biology
- Mammalian cell culture experience and an interest in working with mouse models are desirable 
- Collaborative, highly motivated working style with good attention to detail
- Excellent written and spoken English

What makes this Position special:

- A fully funded PhD position within the DKFZ International PhD Program
- Close supervision and mentoring in an international research environment 
- Participate in collaborations with leading cancer research groups
- Hands-on experience using cutting-edge technologies, including CRISPR-based functional genomics, next-generation sequencing, imaging, and advanced disease models 
- Access to excellent core facilities at both DKFZ Heidelberg and Charité Berlin

We Offer

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
- Access to international research networks
- Doctoral salary with the usual social benefits
- 30 days of vacation per year
- Flexible working hours
- Possibility of part-time work
- Family-friendly working environment
- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket
- Unleash your full potential: targeted training and mentoring through the DKFZ International PhD Program and DKFZ Career Service
- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being

Are you interested?

Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!

Contact:

Amulya Sreekumar
Phone: +49 (0)30 450 559399

Duration: The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of prolongation.

Application Deadline: September 23, 2026

Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.

Please also note that we cannot return applications submitted by post.

We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. People with severe disabilities are given preference if they have the same aptitude.

Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world's most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of nearly 51,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

AECOM has a multidisciplinary team working with Data Centre clients across both Hyperscale and Colocation and Enterprise projects across Western Europe.

This job opening focusses on the German Market, seeking someone with a strong Design Management background in the local DC sector.

This will require deep engagement to materialize and to ensure and timely delivery, meeting the recurring clients’ deadlines, budget and requirements.

The design manager identifies the right level and capability of resources to be deployed on the project. It is the design managers responsibility to ensure the right level of bidding and pricing of new opportunities ensuring they are delivered as sold fees and margins. Thus, implying Project Management capabilities.

**Job Responsibilities:** 

- Design Management in a high paced project environment in the German market
- Covering multidisciplinary cross regional teams of CSA & MEP
- Assisting bids commercially and technically for multi-disciplinary opportunities with key clients
- Ensuring all internal as well as local regulatory governance is followed: both at bid stage and throughout the delivery of projects

Qualifications

- Senior Multidisciplinary Design Manager (MEP / Architectural Background)
- DC Experience in accountable DM position
- Proficient in contractual German and English
- Ability to manage a busy workload and deadlines
- Excellent communication skills are essential

Additional Information

Why join us?
You will love the freedom to bring your own ideas and vision to life, combining client management, project delivery, and team leadership. You will value working alongside colleagues with outstanding technical expertise in a collaborative, caring, and supportive team environment. We offer a flexible working environment, a competitive salary, and a culture that places safety, wellbeing, and professional development at the heart of everything we do.

If you are looking to work for one of the world’s most trusted global environmental consulting firms and help shape a more sustainable future for Germany and beyond, the AECOM Germany team looks forward to welcoming you on board.

SAP SS&D (Sovereign Services & Delivery) is looking for an IT Risk & Compliance Specialist (f/m/d) to operate, audit, and further develop the secure infrastructure at our Walldorf location.

In this role, you will serve as the central authority for IT risk management, compliance assurance, and audit coordination within our highly secure operational environment. You will ensure risk-compliant governance of the local IT landscape — including the on-site Micro Data Center — with a strong emphasis on BSI IT-Grundschutz implementation, ISO 27001 adherence, and regulatory alignment.

Your responsibilities span strategic compliance planning and hands-on operational delivery: conducting internal and external audits, maintaining ISMS documentation, driving continuous improvement of the security and compliance posture, and ensuring all systems meet the strictest confidentiality and regulatory requirements for public sector and regulated industry customers.

You will act as a trusted advisor and liaison for compliance- and security-related matters at the Walldorf site, engaging with internal stakeholders, external auditors, and government authorities.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

- Leading IT compliance, audit, and GRC activities in accordance with BSI IT-Grundschutz, ISO 27001, and applicable regulatory requirements
- Preparing, conducting, and following up on audits, including evidence collection, remediation tracking, and coordination with auditors, certification bodies, and authorities
- Creating and maintaining audit-ready IT security and compliance documentation, including IT-Grundschutz and ISMS artefacts, security concepts, risk registers, operating procedures, meeting minutes, and workshop summaries
- Preparing and delivering presentations, management briefings, decision papers, and structured reports on technical, security, compliance, and project-related topics
- Identifying, assessing, documenting, and mitigating operational IT risks and supporting security accreditation processes for classified environments
- Operating and maintaining secure IT infrastructure, including virtualized environments, Active Directory, access controls, backup and recovery, hardened clients, and IT asset management
- Using SIEM solutions, to analyze logs, detect anomalies, and support incident response and forensic activities
- Supporting procurement processes by identifying requirements, coordinating with stakeholders and vendors, and initiating orders when required
- Acting as a central interface between collaborating departments by consolidating requirements, coordinating cross-functional topics, clarifying responsibilities, and ensuring effective information flow
- Coordinating external service providers and acting as the local contact for auditors, customers, stakeholders, and government authorities, including conducting infrastructure tours and technical walkthroughs

What you bring:

You are a committed and proactive IT Risk & Compliance Specialist with a strong background in secure infrastructure operations, regulatory frameworks, and audit management. Your profile should demonstrate experience in several of the following areas:

- Master's degree (or equivalent) in IT, cybersecurity, information security management, or a related field — alternatively, completed vocational training as an IT specialist (Fachinformatiker) with substantial relevant professional experience
- 4+ years of relevant working experience in IT risk, compliance, or secure IT operations
- Strong expertise in Governance, Risk Management & Compliance and Auditing Support — including hands-on experience with BSI IT-Grundschutz, ISO 27001, gap analyses, ISMS implementation, audit preparation, evidence management, and remediation tracking
- Solid understanding of Operational Risk Mitigation and Cyber Security — from identifying and treating IT risks systematically to working with BSI-certified products, secure IT architectures, SIEM platforms (ideally Splunk), and classified environments
- Proven Project Management skills — ability to plan and drive compliance and infrastructure projects independently, on time, and within defined governance frameworks
- Familiarity with AI tools in a professional context: experience applying AI-assisted automation and prototyping, agentic workflows, and context engineering to operational or compliance tasks — paired with a critical eye for AI output quality assurance and the ability to drive AI adoption within the team
- Strong communication and stakeholder skills — excellent written and spoken German and English, with the ability to build trust with internal teams, external auditors, and government authorities, and to translate complex regulatory topics into clear, actionable language for diverse audiences
- Emotional intelligence and customer orientation — empathetic and composed under pressure, with a genuine focus on delivering value and clarity to all stakeholders, even in sensitive or high-stakes situations
- Complex problem-solving mindset — structured and analytical, with the ability to diagnose root causes, evaluate trade-offs, and drive sustainable solutions in ambiguous environments

Experienced Environmental Fate / Modelling Expert (m/f/d)

For more than 25 years RIFCON GmbH is an independent scientific consulting company offering comprehensive professional services for the registration of synthetic and biological plant protection products. Our head office is located in Hirschberg near Heidelberg in Germany. About 200 employees offer services ranging from complete EU registration packages, general consultancy work to sophisticated GLP field studies and various combinations of these elements. Furthermore, we offer environmental planning and environmental monitoring including eDNA services.

Interested in more information? Check what our colleagues say: This is RIFCON

For our Environmental Fate (Efate) team located in Hirschberg or Ludwigshafen / Germany we are looking for an experienced Environmental Fate / Modelling Scientist in full-time.

These tasks are waiting for you

You will be involved in various aspects of registration activities for active substances, plant protection products and biosolutions including:

- Environmental fate risk assessment for biological and chemical plant protection products (calculation of predicted environmental concentrations in soil, groundwater, surface water, air…) and reporting
- Preparation of dossiers for authorization of active substances and plant protection products according to European and national requirements
- Evaluation and monitoring of laboratory and field studies on substance behaviour (e.g. kinetic evaluation of degradation studies to derive half-lives)
- Analyses of studies and data packages for guideline compliance and data gaps
- Close cooperation with our clients, scientific units and regulatory authorities
- Project management and strategic consultancy, development of higher tier strategies for refinement after an extensive 'on-the-job' learning phase

You convince us with

- Scientific background (geoecology, environmental sciences, geography, geoscience or similar)
- Professional experience in environmental fate modelling in either consultancy, authority or industry preferred; motivated candidates with professional experience as study director for environmental fate studies might also be considered for the position
- Knowledge of environmental fate modelling (water and substance transport models, FOCUS models) and behaviour of chemicals in the environment (e.g. degradation kinetics, sorption isotherms)
- Experience with Regulation (EC) 1107/2009 would be advantageous
- Very good working knowledge of MS office tools; experience with programming languages (e.g. R or Python) would be an asset
- Very good level of written and spoken English, additional languages (especially German) are advantageous
- Self-motivation, problem-solving skills and diligent style of working
- Excellent communication and team player skills

What we offer

- An attractive working environment and multifaceted tasks
- Friendly and open working atmosphere
- To work as part of a dedicated international team of scientists and staff
- Possibility of professional development and occupational education
- An opportunity to expand your personal network in industry, science and regulatory bodies
- High degree of project and self-responsibility
- Home office and mobile work opportunities
- Flexible working hours
- Company health insurance (bKV)
- Meal allowance (Essenszuschuss)
- Support of Deutschland Ticket, employee parking spaces, company bike leasing (Jobbike)
- Employer childcare allowance
- Individual ergonomic advices, Yoga and sports
- Team events

Interested?

Then we look forward to receiving your application including your earliest possible starting date via our application form.

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The Photo Injector Test Facility PITZ in Zeuthen (near Berlin) is one of the leading international groups for developing modern photo injectors and their applications. Current R&D goals of PITZ include improving the electron source brightness beyond state of the art for X‑ray Free Electron Lasers as well as applications of high brightness beams, e. g. for most modern cancer radiation therapies like FLASH‑RT and SFRT (FLASHlab@PITZ). The Cherenkov Telescope Array Observatory (CTAO) is the next-generation, ground-based facility for very-high-energy gamma-ray astronomy. It will feature two massive telescope arrays deployed across both the Northern and Southern hemispheres. Operations and scientific data acquisition within the observatory are managed by the Array Control and Data Acquisition (ACADA) system. Within ACADA, the Resource Manager (RM) handles infrastructure administration and system supervision, while the Central Control (CC) orchestrates the execution of astronomical observation workflows.

As software developer, you will work for PITZ to develop server software for the accelerator control system, as well as for the ACADA system's RM and CC subsystems.

About your role:

- Development of server software for the control of different devices at PITZ using the DOOCS API
- Integration of applications into the accelerator control system
- Design and implement core operational subsystems as distributed, container-based software based on structural and behavioural design models
- Develop the orchestration logic to manage dynamic hardware groupings and automate workflows, alongside hierarchical, fault-tolerant architectures for system lifecycles and automated recovery

About you:

- University degree in computer science, physics, mathematics, engineering or related subject, or comparable qualification
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Strong professional experience in C++ and Java; proficiency in Python is advantageous
- Deep knowledge of OOP, functional programming, data structures, and concurrency/multithreading
- Familiarity with state-machine design patterns and distributed consensus mechanisms.
- Proven background in control systems, real-time programming, process automation, or SCADA architectures
- Experience developing communication protocols for hardware and device interfacing
- Strong proficiency in Linux environments and modern DevOps practices (TDD, CI/CD, build automation, Git)
- Strong English communication skills for collaborating in an international, multi-disciplinary team
- Good German communication skills are preferable

Good reasons to join:

- An international research campus enables you to think outside the box
- Basic, materials and applied research broaden your horizons
- Collaborate with exceptional colleagues and researchers
- Our own particle accelerator

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50 %). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV‑AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For further information, please contact Kai Leffhalm at +49 33762 7-7159 (https://tel:+493376277159)  **(kai.leffhalm@desy.de (https://mailto:kai.leffhalm@desy.de) ).**

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Senior Negotiation Lead in the Corporate Strategic Procurement Department at Siemens Energy, you will play a crucial role in shaping and executing high-stakes negotiation strategies that drive value for the company. You will be the go-to expert for complex negotiations, providing both hands-on and strategic guidance to transform settings and outcomes. Each day, you will engage in impactful negotiations, optimize supplier agreements, and enhance procurement processes. Your expertise will directly influence our corporate procurement strategies, contributing to Siemens Energy’s mission of reimagining energy for a sustainable world. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Develop and execute negotiation strategies for complex supplier negotiations, driving cost optimization, cost recovery, risk mitigation, and improved commercial terms
* Lead critical supplier negotiations and provide strategic advice to Procurement leaders on objectives, trade-offs, escalation strategies, and outcomes
* Further develop the negotiation competence hub by establishing consistent negotiation standards, methodologies, and best practices
* Build negotiation capabilities across the organization through coaching, training, and knowledge sharing
* Translate negotiation outcomes and lessons learned into enhanced commodity, supplier, and procurement strategies
* Drive digital innovation and continuous improvement across the negotiation lifecycle, fostering a strong negotiation mindset and culture of excellence

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or MBA is a plus.
* Extensive professional experience in strategic procurement and/or commercial negotiations, with a proven track record in complex, high-stakes environments
* Deep knowledge of negotiation principles and advanced methodologies, combined with strong commercial acumen and excellent analytical and strategic thinking skills.
* Outstanding communication, influencing, and advisory skills, with the ability to effectively challenge and engage senior stakeholders.
* Strong coaching and collaboration skills, with proven ability to build effective cross-functional and international networks and manage multiple priorities.
* Passion for digitalization and innovation, with experience in digital procurement and negotiation tools; fluency in English, with additional languages as an advantage.

About the Team

Our global Special Projects and Transformation team is part of Siemens Energy’s Corporate Commodity  Management organization. We partner with Procurement teams and businesses worldwide to deliver strategic  initiatives, strengthen capabilities, and transform how Procurement creates value.  You will join a collaborative and forward - looking team where diverse perspectives, ownership, and continuous learning are valued.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

In a Nutshell

As a

Maintenance Engineer (m/f/d)
, you’ll work in our soon to open Fulfilment Center in Berlin/Brandenburg (Falkensee) with the latest intralogistics systems from top brands like Apollo, Qimarox, and Regal Rexnord. You’ll be responsible for keeping our Material Handling Equipment running at peak performance, solving malfunctions independently, and implementing improvements. Your insight and initiative are valued, and you’ll coach junior colleagues to elevate the team, ensuring tens of thousands of orders reach families on time every day. During your shift, you take full responsibility for the service and maintenance of our systems.

Troubleshooting malfunctions: You detect and resolve both electrical and mechanical issues in technical systems, working closely with our operational supervisors.

Collaboration with suppliers: For complex problems, you work directly with machine suppliers to find solutions.

Analysis and improvement: You analyze malfunctions, prevent recurrence, and implement structural improvements.

Preventive maintenance: You perform scheduled preventive maintenance to ensure maximum system availability.

You hold an Ausbildung and/or a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field (e.g., mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, mechatronics, automation, etc.)
You have 7+ years of experience in a technical or maintenance role
You have hands-on knowledge of electrical and mechanical systems, including measurement and camera systems
You have been working with software tools such as CMMS and/or ICS/SCADA tools
You have strong communication skills and enjoy collaborating in a team
At the same time, you are independent, take initiative, and solve problems in a goal-oriented way
You're fluent in English and/or German

Smart Commute: Choose the way you move. You will get a company car (with private use) and can make use of our “Lease-a-Bike” program.

Time to recharge: With 30 days of vacation per year (based on a 40-hour workweek in a shift system), you can strike the perfect balance between work and leisure.

Fuel for Winners: Enjoy fresh, free breakfasts and lunches every day in our Fulfilment Center, along with all the snacks and fruit you need to stay fueled.

Kickstart your career: Join our international team in an environment that fosters real growth and an “Act like an Owner” mentality. Here, you’ll have the chance to drive projects independently, test new ideas, and level up through specialized Lepaya trainings to see firsthand how your work makes an impact.

Sustainability at Core: Be part of the revolution. You’ll contribute to a greener future through our 100% electric fleet and a business model designed to drastically reduce food waste.

The Essentials: We provide the tools for success, including a laptop and phone, and access to exclusive Corporate Benefits discounts for travel, tech and more.

Unforgettable Moments: From our legendary annual ski trip, our massive Christmas parties, to parties featuring our very own Picnic band, we make sure our milestones are celebrated in style.

Well-being & Balance: Professional mental health support via OpenUp.
